forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 38, 4 survey and 4 clearance teams were active. They completed 1 zone survey, 3 visits and 1 clearance; no technical surveys were completed. So far, 27 zones have been surveyed, 9 declared free, 28 areas released and 13 cleared.

No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried. The access feed shows 8 zones closed. No new plan was approved; the plan remains P09.

The forecast, made in week 36 for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, gives a range of 11 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 10 zones declared free.
